label: Explicit 1D DP with descending capacities (recommended live test)

setup: I sort the items by their value-to-weight ratio, then pick the highest-ratio items that fit. Each item is considered once.

The ratio-greedy strategy fails here: picking A and B has weight 30 and value 160, but B and C has weight 50 and value 220. Greedy can miss a better feasible combination because it commits to a local choice.
input.tested_message: I can solve 0/1 Knapsack with a one-dimensional DP array, where dp[w] represents the maximum value achievable at capacity w. I process each item once and update capacities from W down to the item's weight. The recurrence is dp[w] = max(dp[w], value + dp[w-weight]). The first term skips the current item, while the second takes it. Descending iteration ensures dp[w-weight] has not yet been updated using the current item, so I cannot use an item more than once.
